passages.text: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles...
passages.sermon:
I am Paul.
I am a prisoner of Christ Jesus.
I am a prisoner for your sake.
You are Gentiles.
For this reason, I speak to you.
passages.original: Τούτου χάριν ἐγὼ Παῦλος ὁ δέσμιος τοῦ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν

passages.text: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you, that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.
passages.sermon:
Paul is the writer.
Paul is a servant of Christ Jesus.
God gave Paul a special responsibility.
God gave Paul this responsibility for the Gentiles.
God gave Paul the stewardship of His grace.
God gave this grace to Paul for the sake of the Gentiles.
God made a mystery known to Paul.
God revealed this mystery to Paul by revelation.
Paul wrote about this mystery before.
Paul wrote about it briefly.
passages.original: Εἴ γε ἠκούσατε τὴν οἰκονομίαν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς ὅτι κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν ἐγνωρίσθη μοι τὸ μυστήριον καθὼς προέγραψα ἐν ὀλίγῳ

passages.text: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ, which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.
passages.sermon:
Paul wrote this letter.
Paul is a prisoner for Christ Jesus.
Paul writes to Gentile believers.
You can read what Paul wrote.
When you read, you can understand Paul's insight.
Paul has insight into the mystery of Christ.
God did not make this mystery known to people in past generations.
God has now revealed this mystery.
The Holy Spirit revealed it.
God revealed it to His holy apostles and prophets.
passages.original: πρὸς ὃ δύνασθε ἀναγινώσκοντες νοῆσαι τὴν σύνεσίν μου ἐν τῷ μυστηρίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὃ ἑτέραις γενεαῖς οὐκ ἐγνωρίσθη τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὡς νῦν ἀπεκαλύφθη τοῖς ἁγίοις ἀποστόλοις αὐτοῦ καὶ προφήταις ἐν Πνεύματι

passages.text: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are fellow heirs, fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus.
passages.sermon:
Paul is the writer.
Paul explains a mystery from God.
God revealed this mystery to Paul.
The gospel makes this mystery known.
The Gentiles are included in this mystery.
The Gentiles are fellow heirs with the Jews.
The Gentiles are fellow members of the body of Christ.
The Gentiles share in the promise in Christ Jesus.
The Gentiles receive these blessings through the gospel.
passages.original: εἶναι τὰ ἔθνη συνκληρονόμα καὶ σύσσωμα καὶ συμμέτοχα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου

passages.text: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God’s grace, given me through the working of His power.
passages.sermon:
Paul is the speaker.
\r\nPaul became a servant of the gospel.
\r\nGod gave Paul this role as a gift of grace.
\r\nGod gave this grace to Paul by His power.
passages.original: οὗ ἐγενήθην διάκονος κατὰ τὴν δωρεὰν τῆς χάριτος τοῦ Θεοῦ τῆς δοθείσης μοι κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ

passages.text: Though I am less than the least of all the saints, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ, and to illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery, which for ages past was kept hidden in God, who created all things.
passages.sermon:
Paul is the speaker.
\r\nPaul is a servant of Christ.
\r\nPaul considers himself less than the least of all the saints.
\r\nGod gave Paul grace.
\r\nGod gave Paul this grace for a purpose.
\r\nGod sent Paul to preach to the Gentiles.
\r\nPaul preaches the unsearchable riches of Christ.
\r\nGod also gave Paul a second purpose.
\r\nPaul must illuminate for everyone the stewardship of this mystery.
\r\nThis mystery was hidden for ages.
\r\nGod kept this mystery hidden in Himself.
\r\nGod created all things.
passages.original: Ἐμοὶ τῷ ἐλαχιστοτέρῳ πάντων ἁγίων ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις αὕτη τοῖς ἔθνεσιν εὐαγγελίσασθαι τὸ ἀνεξιχνίαστον πλοῦτος τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ φωτίσαι πάντας τίς ἡ οἰκονομία τοῦ μυστηρίου τοῦ ἀποκεκρυμμένου ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων ἐν τῷ Θεῷ τῷ τὰ πάντα κτίσαντι

passages.text: His purpose was that now, through the church, the manifold wisdom of God should be made known to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms, according to the eternal purpose that He accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
passages.sermon:
God has an eternal purpose.
God accomplished this purpose in Christ Jesus our Lord.
God wants His manifold wisdom to be made known now.
God makes His wisdom known through the church.
God reveals His wisdom to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly realms.
passages.original: ἵνα γνωρισθῇ νῦν ταῖς ἀρχαῖς καὶ ταῖς ἐξουσίαις ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις διὰ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἡ πολυποίκιλος σοφία τοῦ Θεοῦ κατὰ πρόθεσιν τῶν αἰώνων ἣν ἐποίησεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ Κυρίῳ ἡμῶν

passages.text: In Him and through faith in Him we may enter God’s presence with boldness and confidence.
passages.sermon:
Christ Jesus is our Lord.
God accomplished His eternal purpose in Christ Jesus.
In Christ, we have access to God.
We come to God through faith in Christ.
We may enter God’s presence.
We can come with boldness.
We can come with confidence.
passages.original: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν παρρησίαν καὶ προσαγωγὴν ἐν πεποιθήσει διὰ τῆς πίστεως αὐτοῦ

passages.text: So I ask you not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.
passages.sermon:
Paul is writing to the believers in Ephesus.
Paul is suffering for their sake.
Paul asks them not to lose heart.
Paul tells them not to be discouraged by his troubles.
Paul says his sufferings are for their benefit.
Paul says his sufferings are their glory.
passages.original: Διὸ αἰτοῦμαι μὴ ἐνκακεῖν ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσίν μου ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἥτις ἐστὶν δόξα ὑμῶν

passages.text: ... for this reason I bow my knees before the Father, from whom every family in heaven and on earth derives its name.
passages.sermon:
Paul is the writer of this letter.
Paul is a servant of Jesus Christ.
Paul bows his knees before the Father.
The Father is God.
Every family in heaven receives its name from the Father.
Every family on earth receives its name from the Father.
passages.original: Τούτου χάριν κάμπτω τὰ γόνατά μου πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα ἐξ οὗ πᾶσα πατριὰ ἐν οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ γῆς ὀνομάζεται

passages.text: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being, so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love, will have power, together with all the saints, to comprehend the length and width and height and depth of the love of Christ, and to know this love that surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.
passages.sermon:
God is glorious and rich.
God gives strength to you.
God gives this strength through His Spirit.
God works in your inner being.
God wants Christ to live in your hearts.
You receive Christ in your hearts through faith.
God wants you to be rooted in love.
God wants you to be grounded in love.
God gives you power.
You have this power together with all the saints.
God wants you to understand the love of Christ.
God’s love is wide.
God’s love is long.
God’s love is high.
God’s love is deep.
God wants you to know the love of Christ.
The love of Christ is greater than knowledge.
God wants you to be filled with all His fullness.
passages.original: ἵνα δῷ ὑμῖν κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ δυνάμει κραταιωθῆναι διὰ τοῦ Πνεύματος αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν ἔσω ἄνθρωπον κατοικῆσαι τὸν Χριστὸν διὰ τῆς πίστεως ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν ἐν ἀγάπῃ ἐρριζωμένοι καὶ τεθεμελιωμένοι ἵνα ἐξισχύσητε καταλαβέσθαι σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἁγίοις τί τὸ πλάτος καὶ μῆκος καὶ ὕψος καὶ βάθος γνῶναί τε τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν τῆς γνώσεως ἀγάπην τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα πληρωθῆτε εἰς πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: Now to Him who is able to do so much more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us, to Him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.
passages.sermon:
God is able to do much more than we ask.
God is able to do much more than we imagine.
God does this by His power.
His power works within us.
Glory belongs to God in the church.
Glory belongs to God in Christ Jesus.
God deserves glory through all generations.
God deserves glory forever and ever.
Amen.
passages.original: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ ὑπὲρ πάντα ποιῆσαι ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ὧν αἰτούμεθα ἢ νοοῦμεν κατὰ τὴν δύναμιν τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἡμῖν αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα ἐν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς πάσας τὰς γενεὰς τοῦ αἰῶνος τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
